mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation models and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment rate increase above 9.5% over three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate monetary policy misstep, increasing market uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 90) indicates supply shock, increasing production costs and reducing corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 90.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 610,000) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 610,000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts below 600,000 signal weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 600.

mechanism_narrative: High interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) indicates restrictive monetary policy, dampening economic activity and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak labor growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% MoM) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signal deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting both PAYEMS and UNRATE conditions.
